content.comment_body: Hello, I've set up a weekly time user-defined function and want to display both set hours and remaining hours until changeover in the message text. I accomplished this in [product_name] [version_no]. However, the user-defined function and its related blocks aren't visible in the block list of the text block's properties window. Does anyone know what might be causing this issue? Thanks in advance, [user_name]
If you're working inside the user-defined function, try opening its properties and publishing any information you need to access outside of it.
[product_name] [article_no] does NOT support user-defined function. Only [article_no] supports user-defined function.
Yes, I understand. I should have mentioned this program worked fine with version [version_no].

Thank you, I've managed to get one block working now, but I still can't display the hour counter parameters in the user-defined function properties so that I can publish them. The program is identical to the one that previously worked with the older software.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having trouble accessing parameters of user-defined function blocks within the message text block list in the properties window. This feature was available in previous software versions, but now both the user-defined function and its blocks are not selectable, which disrupts normal workflow. There is also confusion about which hardware versions support user-defined functions, impacting usability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to easily select and display user-defined function blocks and their parameters in the message text block list, just like they could in earlier versions. They are hoping for consistent user-defined function support between hardware and software versions, allowing simple access, parameter publishing, and manipulation within message text blocks.
